sheets.prompt: Create one clean 3:4 vertical studio cutout sheet with exactly three separate photoreal commercial objects arranged top, middle, and bottom with very wide spacing. Match the supplied references only for bright youthful pink editorial art direction; do not reproduce any text or interface from them. Top: one generic satin metallic insulated bottle in bright warm pink, three-quarter view. Middle: one matching generic rectangular product box in pale pink with a simple embossed bottle silhouette but no branding. Bottom: one modern black smartphone shell at a slight angle with a completely blank neutral-dark screen, no interface. Every object must be isolated and fully visible, with crisp edges, soft neutral frontal light, controlled satin surfaces, no transparency and no green reflections. Background must be one perfectly uniform solid chroma key green #00FF00 across the entire image, flat and shadowless, with no gradient, texture, vignette or floor. No people, no mascot, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no user interface, no fourth object, no green-colored subject details, no glossy mirror reflections.
